name: Bold Heelspike
description: Keep the point against the target after the first touch and press forward with the whole body.

name: Fierce Leafhead
description: Slip the point under a raised arm and jab into the gap at the target's side.

name: Levering Stretch
description: Set the leaf-blade's base in the crook of the opponent's elbow and press it away from the chest.

name: Twirlcurl
description: Drag the rear heel along the ground as the lead foot advances to close in without losing the stance.

name: Stalwart Spearpoint
description: Turn the shaft flat across the hip line with qi in the wood to stop a cut at the body.

name: Slideshaft Flog
description: Feed qi down the haft in a steady stream while pressing the held point deep through armour padding.

name: Brisk Bladewings
description: Roll the wrists to slip the point out from under a bind and thrust at the opened line.

name: Thrustflog
description: Pass the shaft hand over hand once, ending in a thrust that begins from the opposite side.

name: Keen Collarband
description: Pass the shaft underhand to bring the point up from low into a quick jab at the belly.

name: Sturdy Longshaft
description: Parry on one side and cycle the shaft to the other hand ready for the opposite parry.

name: Beatback Stalk
description: Step as the shaft passes between the hands so the cycle never leaves the body off balance.

name: Buttressed Buttshoe
description: Spin the shaft once across the front of the body to cover against a short rush.

name: Entangling Bindcord
description: Slide the shaft against the opponent's weapon while switching hands so the other weapon is carried aside.

name: Vicious Ferrule
description: Cycle the shaft through four passes, each ending in a thrust aimed at a different line.

name: Buttshoe Barrier
description: Cycle the shaft against the direction of an enemy sweep to carry it wide and open its owner.

name: Dense Ferrule
description: Spin the shaft in a flowing wheel with a thin sheet of qi in each pass to blunt several strikes.

name: Socketswat
description: Advance two quick steps after a retreating opponent and thrust on the second.

name: Ruthless Pushthrough
description: Slide the lead foot forward and settle the weight before the jab goes out.

name: Scudding Bindcord
description: Hop back a pace with the point held out to cut off a following attack.

name: Raw Beatback
description: Skip sideways and prick the point into the side of an opponent turning to face the move.

name: Prowling Heelspike
description: Cross the rear foot behind the lead foot to angle the body round an opponent.

name: Cramping Spearpoint
description: Pause mid-step to break the rhythm of an opponent timing the next thrust.

name: Twofold Slideshaft
description: Join three steps and three thrusts at rising heights in a ladder that climbs the opponent's body.

name: Rugged Longshaft
description: Break the walking rhythm with a stagger and lunge in at the unready opponent.

name: Binding Leafhead
description: Press the shaft along the length of an opposing haft and hold it pinned against the body.

name: Viselike Pushthrough
description: Catch the opponent's thrust on the shaft and slide along it to the blade's base.

name: Collarband Hasp
description: Slide the shaft under the opposing haft and lever it upward to expose the chest.

name: Clutching Bladewings
description: Set the point against the throat while the opposing weapon is bound and hold the target still.

name: Stubborn Ferrule
description: Draw back from a bind with the shaft angled to carry an enemy thrust off line.

name: Burdening Stretch
description: Lean the body's weight onto the shaft crossed over the opposing haft to bear it down.

name: Spearscorer
description: Draw a small circle with the point around the bound shaft and thrust through the opening.

name: Tethering Bladewings
description: Spiral the shaft around the opposing haft to steer it away from the target's own line.

name: Pointbarrier
description: Anchor the bind with qi in the arms so the opposing shaft cannot break free.

name: Spearslap
description: Lunge deep with the shaft held diagonally so the haft screens the head while the point strikes.

name: Unmoving Longshaft
description: Recover from a lunge by swinging the haft across the body to turn an answering strike.

name: Gritsocket
description: Spring from the rear leg to cross a long gap in one bound with the point forward.

name: Pointswat
description: Jab low at the knee of an advancing opponent to halt the advance.

name: Rill Spearpoint
description: Raise the haft above the lead arm as the lunge finishes to guard against a cut.

name: Rillthrust
description: Pull the lunging body back by the rear foot and reset the guard before a counter lands.

name: Comettwirl
description: Lunge, slip aside from the answer and thrust again into the opponent as it passes.

name: Shielding Heelspike
description: Set the lunge with qi in the legs so the body takes a counter-blow without being moved.

name: Armored Leafhead
description: Hold the point high with the haft sloping down across the front to deflect cuts from above.

name: Lurching Collarband
description: Drop the high point suddenly onto the opponent's shoulder as it presses through the guard.

name: Poise Buttshoe
description: Slide a blow down the slanted shaft and off the body without breaking the stance.

name: Kindly Bindcord
description: Feel the incoming pressure through the rear hand held high and read the direction of attack.

name: Padded Bindcord
description: Hold qi in the raised shaft so overhead blows are caught and slide off without force.

name: Twirlflog
description: Switch from hanging guard to a low thrust at the thigh, dropping the shaft in one turn.

name: Duskthrust
description: Drive the shaft down in a pressing hammer-stroke on the opposing arms to break the guard.

name: Pointslap
description: Swing the shaft in a wide horizontal arc to strike across the target's guard.

name: Wild Beatback
description: Sweep the shaft low in an arc across the opponent's calves.

name: Harsh Slideshaft
description: Whirl the shaft overhead in a ring and bring it down on the opponent's guard.

name: Gritspear
description: Step inside the arc of a sweep to cut down the opponent's reach.

name: Guarding Heelspike
description: Bring the shaft back from a sweep into a guard that blocks a counter cut.

name: Gall Pushthrough
description: Beat the opposing blade away from the body's outer edge with the sweep.

name: Principle Stretch
description: Follow a wide sweep with a turn that brings the point forward into the opened line.

name: Acrid Bladewings
description: Sweep the shaft in two crossing arcs, high then low, to strike and drive back nearby foes.

name: Momentsocket
description: Push qi into the leaf-blade's edge on a flat sweep so it presses on the target's guard.

name: Collarband Flog
description: Thrust on the count of a drill leader in step with the line on either side.

name: Thrustcurl
description: Shift a shoulder's width to close a gap in the line without lowering the point.

name: Rill Leafhead
description: Brace the heel and lower the point to receive a charge as one of a line.

name: Spearthwack
description: Jab past the shoulder of the ranks ahead to strike a target beyond their guard.

name: Springing Buttshoe
description: Reset the foot to the drill count after a thrust so the line stays even.

name: Genial Spearpoint
description: Carry the spear with qi in the arms and keep the point steady over a long march.

name: Twirlthwack
description: Lower the point and thrust forward as part of a line that meets a mounted rush together.

name: Sleet Longshaft
description: Brace with qi in the legs so the line withstands a shove against the shafts.

name: Omen Beatback
description: Pull back through the ranks and strike when next in the front line.

name: Stalling Stretch
description: Send the point toward the face and drag it back to pull the guard upward.

name: Honed Ferrule
description: Follow a high feint with a fully committed thrust to the belly beneath the raised guard.

name: Miragesocket
description: Dip the shoulder in a false lunge to draw the opponent's thrust before the true one.

name: Recall Longshaft
description: Hold the opponent's eyes with the point's line and watch for the glance that betrays a guard shift.

name: Staticpoint
description: Hold the thrust a beat late, then strike when the opponent's guard has already moved.

name: Brawnspear
description: Step out of range after a failed feint before the opponent's counter lands.

name: Purpose Slideshaft
description: Throw two feints in succession at different heights and finish with a thrust at the third.

name: Swift Pushthrough
description: Slip the point under the answering parry and jab into the turned side.

name: Thrustslap
description: Quicken the hands with qi to change the point's aim twice within one extension.

name: Socketslap
description: Thrust to meet an advancing opponent at the end of the point's reach, stopping the step before it lands.

name: Haze Collarband
description: Turn the shaft to parry and send the point forward in the same turn.

name: Twirlslap
description: Slip off the line of a thrust and prick the exposed forearm as it extends.

name: Lithe Beatback
description: Step back on the return of a counter to hold the distance a hand beyond the opponent's reach.

name: Draught Leafhead
description: Check an incoming shaft with a short sidelong push and set the point on the opponent's centre.

name: Pointscreen
description: Step too close with the point lowered so the opponent thrusts into a prepared counter.

name: Poise Bindcord
description: Slide an enemy blade down the haft and turn the body aside to avoid the follow-through.

name: Plied Bladewings
description: Parry, step, thrust and recover as one unbroken series answering a three-strike attack.

name: Thrustswat
description: Retreat one pace on the opponent's strike and drive the point into the chest as it follows.

name: Gagging Pushthrough
description: Back the counter-beat with qi in the shaft so the opponent's weapon is knocked clear of the line.
